name: Known Powers
summary: Known power progression is now merged into the Psyker and Aeldari Warlock class level tables in sections 11.3 and 11.12. Use those tables for Minor, Standard, and Major powers known. Characters with Touched by the Warp still know one Minor Universal power only, unless a class feature, relic, corruption event, or GM reward says otherwise.
